input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (stored owner prompt)
task: Deepen (flagship 6): shift-roster-builder, the 60x168 end-to-end week 0 (root LP 275.2 h vs 300 h held)

errors.what: first integration fed the clique floor to the whole-score column generation as its open-hours row; week 0's score root fell to 212 h and week 1 lost its pay proof under the budget
errors.fix: dropped the row; clique floor proves coverage only, runs after column generation on big weeks

errors.what: open-sums.test.mjs failed: the clique floor lifted by openSumLift proved coverage with openSums: false
errors.fix: clique floor respects openSums: false (no lift)

doc_friction.issue: the shift-roster-builder next item framed 275.2 h vs 300 h as a gap to close; an independent ILP showed 300 was already optimal and the 275 an unconverged bound. Checking which side of a gap is wrong first would have saved earlier runs.
pyenv.py install of scipy took ~2 min as warned; fine. ilp-export.mjs built the roster before dumping, so big weeks could not be dumped quickly (added NOBUILD=1).

notes: HiGHS proved 60x168 week 0 = 300 h in 4.9 s (pairwise model; root 300 after clique presolve), week 1 = 308 h in 479 s. New cliqueOpenFloor (compact LP with interval-graph clique rows, dual bound) gives 300/308 in 1.1-1.3 s, 80-person 257/331/281 in 4.5-6.3 s, 100-person 358/344 in 13-15 s (same as engine roots). End to end 60x168 week 0, 20 s budget: 21.1 s unproven -> 15.7 s coverage proven; no budget 59.3 -> 38.7 s. Week 1 unchanged (proven, clique not run). 40x112 week 0 unchanged (proven). Brute force on 240 tiny weeks: never above least, tight on 174/223. Full venture suite: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder -> 1 suites run, 0 failed. HiGHS on clique MIP for 100-person weeks, 300 s: 368/358 and 367/344.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an OR engineer diagnosing a bound gap with an outside ILP, writing and validating a compact clique LP with a dual bound, integrating and benchmarking it

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
